sessions.text:
User: I have a pile of emails to write this week and I'm behind. Before we start, from now on, end every email with 'Regards, Priya' on its own last line.
Assistant: Got it, every email ends with 'Regards, Priya' on its own line. What kinds of emails are in the pile?
User: A few to people in my building. From now on, when I write to a neighbour, make the first line 'Hey there,'.
Assistant: Understood: for neighbours the first line is 'Hey there,'.
User: Thanks. I'll send the first one soon.

User: Separate thing: I'm sorting out my inbox and some old drafts.
Assistant: Okay. Anything about how you want the replies to open?
User: Quick question first: how long is it polite to wait before sending a reminder?
Assistant: A week is usually fine for non-urgent matters, a few days if there's a deadline.
User: By default, open every email with 'To whom it may concern,'.
Assistant: Noted: every email opens with 'To whom it may concern,' unless you say otherwise.
User: Thanks, that's all for now.
